The treatment system consists of an influent diversion box, three equalization tanks, an automatic bar screen, an oxidation ditch, and a secondary clarifier.
The wastewater undergoes biological treatment in the oxidation ditch, followed by solids separation in the secondary clarifier.

Effluent is chlorinated using sodium hypochlorite solution and dechlorinated using a sodium bisulfite prior to discharge.

The Facility also maintains a 4-million-gallon overflow storage pond with a synthetic liner, which can divert flow from the equalization tanks.

A portion of the solids separated in the secondary clarifier is pumped back to the oxidation ditch for additional treatment and the remaining portion is pumped to one of six drying beds, dried, and placed in trash bins prior to being hauled away by a contractor.
